description: Negative (excluded) keywords configured on a SEARCH campaign for a marketplace: one row per negative keyword text, scoped to a given marketing campaign_id (optionally an advertiser os_client_id). A dimension/directory report (keyword text only, no measures) — the downstream layer derives the negative-keyword list and its count. Structural predicates keep only active negatives (is_negative=1, is_deleted=0). A campaign_id filter is required to select which campaign's exclusions to inspect.

keyword.description: The negative (excluded) keyword text configured on the campaign.

campaign_id.description: Marketing campaign_id that owns the negative keyword. Mandatory filter: pass the marketing campaign_id whose exclusions to inspect.

os_client_id.description: Advertiser OnlineSales client_id owning the campaign (working id for internal analysis). Optional filter to further scope to one advertiser.

placeholder_metric.description: Constant-zero placeholder so this dimension (negative-keyword directory) report satisfies the engine's minimum-one-metric requirement; not a real measure.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_ads_db_campaign_level_keywords` AS k JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON SAFE_CAST(k.marketplace_client_id AS STRING) = mc.marketplace_client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND k.is_negative = 1 AND k.is_deleted = 0 AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
